race.title: All Weather Championship Handicap
race.verdict: SECRET SANTA hasn't stood much racing to date but the form of his winning reappearance back in May makes him very hard to overlook in this race so he's taken to cope with the step up in trip and absence. Asuka is fit and firing so looks sure to give his running and be bang there, while Rogue Messiah is well worth this try in headgear and needs keeping an eye on. SECRET SANTA (IRE) ASUKA ROGUE MESSIAH (IRE)
